title: Auth service (users, sessions, tokens)
blurb: A small authentication service on http.server + SQLite: PBKDF2 password hashing with per-user salt, login throttling after failed attempts, opaque session tokens stored only as hashes, expiry and logout, and HMAC-signed short-lived access tokens. HTTP tests on loopback.
keywords: \b(auth(?:entication)? service|login (?:service|system|api)|sign[- ]?up and login|user accounts?|session tokens?|password hashing|jwt)\b
